entities.summary: Hans-Hermann Hoppe is a German-American academic associated with Austrian School economics, anarcho-capitalism, right-wing libertarianism, and opposition to democracy. He is a senior fellow of the Mises Institute think tank. In 2006 he emigrated to Turkey and founded the Property and Freedom Society. Some of the speakers at the organization's conferences in Turkey have been white nationalists. Hans-Hermann Hoppe was a writers & intellectuals from Peine (b. 1949-09-02, Peine). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
